[Not that we need it at this point, but a double Cadence made AA's tableau too pretty to not play the turn out. This one was a doozy - check my work if you don't mind.]

Start of Turn:

Play Phase:
       Play Arcane Cadence:
            ~ Instrumental Conjuration to hand
            ~ Syncopated Onslaught to top of deck
            ~ Rhapsody of Vigor to bottom of deck
            ~ Cedistic Dissonant to trash
            ~ Play Arcane Cadence:
                    ~ Syncopated Onslaught to hand
                    ~ Arcane Cadence to top of deck
                    ~ Rhapsody of Vigor to bottom of deck
                    ~ Vernal Sonata to trash
                    ~ Play Musaragni's Harp

Power Phase: 

      Activate Musaragni's Harp:
          1) Alacritous Subdominant Perform (P) to play Instrumental Conjuration:
              1.1) Search deck and play Xu's Bell, shuffle deck, draw Polyphoric Flare.
          2) Alacritous Subdominant Accompany (A) to activate Telamon's Lyra:
              2.1) Alacritous Subdominant (P) to play Silver Shadow:
                    2.1.1) Alacritous Subdominant (A) to activate Vocalize:
                             2.1.1.1) Alacritous Subdominant (P) to play Syncopated Onslaught
                    2.1.2) Play Polyphoric Flare, take 2 energy damage [22] to activate Xu's Bell:
                             2.1.2.1) Syncopated Onslaught (P) >> 2 heroes get +1 damage dealt until the start of my next turn
                             2.1.2.2) Inventive Preparation (A) >> 1 player may play one card now
               2.2) Inventive Preparation (A) >> 1 player may play one card now [destroy Alacritous Subdominant]
